verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's relayed authorisation webhook is well documented: developers receive authorization requests on their own servers, have a fixed 2000ms budget to approve/decline in real time, and can configure a documented fallback (default approval or default refusal) if they don't respond in time. This directly matches the story's requirements for a time-boxed webhook and controllable timeout fallback. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs.
